messages.content: My wife cannot get away early enough for the 7:20 Friday flight. Please compare the last Friday departure with an early Saturday flight. Keep the graduation and Monday return as they were, and show me the full totals for both university-area stays.

I found one practical option each way. Friday's last nonstop leaves Atlanta at 9:40 p.m. and reaches Minneapolis at 11:18 p.m. The Saturday nonstop leaves at 7:05 a.m. and arrives at 8:43 a.m. Both use the unchanged Monday flight leaving Minneapolis at 4:35 p.m. and arriving in Atlanta at 8:02 p.m. I'll reprice the two tickets and the Graduate stay for three nights versus two nights.
Good. Saturday dinner is still at 6:30 in Edina, so make sure the morning flight leaves enough margin.

It does. Allowing time to leave the airport, you should reach the hotel around 10:00 a.m. The Graduate will store both bags if the room is not ready. Leaving the hotel around 5:45 p.m. should get you to dinner comfortably.
What are the two totals now?

Late Friday: two Main Cabin tickets are $1,044, the king room for May 15-18 is $642 including taxes, and rideshares remain estimated at $120. Total: $1,806. Early Saturday: two Main Cabin tickets are $916, the same room for May 16-18 is $438 including taxes, and estimated rideshares are $124. Total: $1,478. Saturday saves $328 and removes Friday's hotel night.
Does either airfare include a checked bag, and what happens if the Saturday flight is delayed?

Neither fare includes checked bags. Current pricing is $35 for the first checked bag per person each way. The Saturday flight gives you nearly ten hours before dinner; even a delay of several hours would preserve a reasonable cushion. A cancellation would be more disruptive because later nonstop availability is limited that day.
We will carry on. Is the two-night hotel rate still cancelable?

Yes. The two-night rate can be canceled without charge through 11:59 p.m. Central time on May 14. After that deadline, the hotel charges one night's room and tax. The airfare is nonrefundable but can be changed, with any fare difference applying.
Then take the Saturday option. One room for both of us, May 16 through May 18, and keep the Monday return. Use the traveler details and payment card already on file. No insurance or extras.
The amount due now is $1,354: $916 for both airline tickets and $438 for the room. Rideshares are only an estimate and will be paid during the trip. May I complete both purchases for $1,354?

Both reservations are confirmed. Delta confirmation R6T9KP covers two travelers on the nonstop from Atlanta to Minneapolis Saturday, May 16, departing at 7:05 a.m. and arriving at 8:43 a.m., with the unchanged nonstop return Monday, May 18, departing at 4:35 p.m. and arriving at 8:02 p.m. The total airfare charged is $916. Graduate by Hilton Minneapolis confirmation GH-582164 is for one king room for two adults, May 16-18, at $438 including taxes. Cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. Central time May 14, and bag storage before check-in is noted. No insurance, checked bags, or optional extras were added. The booked total is $1,354; including estimated rideshares, the trip total is $1,478.
